name: Governance reforms
focus: Strengthen the rule of law, accountability, efficiency and citizen engagement, including reviving the constitutional review process.

name: Public-finance reforms
focus: Modernise the tax system, improve expenditure management, raise revenue mobilisation and keep public debt sustainable.

name: Industrial and private-sector reforms
focus: Improve the business and investment climate, modernise SEZ and EPZ operations, expand PPP frameworks, lift SME competitiveness and attract quality investment.

name: Skills and human-capital reforms
focus: Align the workforce with a modern, knowledge-intensive economy through technical training, digital literacy and innovation capacity.

name: Digital-governance reforms
focus: Expand e-government, cut bureaucratic delays, modernise the business registry and licensing, and push digital service delivery across every sector.

name: Spatial and environmental reforms
focus: Order urbanisation, land management, real estate and environmental governance so spatial and demographic change stays orderly and sustainable.
